description: Retrieve a supporting file of a vocabulary skill, rendered for the active project and the calling client.

uri.description: Supporting file URI linked from a SKILL.md.

section.description: Optional heading anchor from the file's section index; returns only that section.

plan_id.description: Plan scope used to resolve the project and its domain configuration, or the literal NO_PLAN for the workspace scope. Exactly one of plan_id or epic_id is required (server-enforced).

epic_id.description: Epic scope used to resolve the project and its domain configuration. Mutually exclusive with plan_id.
